Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions in debt financing for Nscale’s AI data center project in West Virginia.

The discussions follow Anthropic signing a multi-billion dollar contract for the first building, which is slated to use Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips.

Nvidia has steadily expanded credit support and investments across major cloud providers and AI partners.
